version_history.note: Refreshed tools/pib_index.py (india-trade-sector-policy-recommendations repo) through 2026-09-14 on a machine that can reach pib.gov.in (this sandbox cannot). Classified the 553 new central releases (27 Aug-14 Sep) against the post's existing 48-scheme keyword taxonomy using the same method the post's own text already documents (title keyword matching, not manual review) -- tightened a few keywords first after catching two substring false positives in a first pass ("Simplify" matching "pli", "SVANidhi" matching "nidhi") that the post's own caveat text specifically warns about. 10 releases genuinely matched: BharatNet (+1), PM-SETU (+1), ECLGS (+1), PMKSY (+1), India Semiconductor Mission/Semicon (+2), and 4 Cabinet/CCEA items (two railway multitracking approvals, each with a CCEA + a Ministry of Railways press release). Updated the subtitle, the top stats strip (central announcements 129->139, unmapped Cabinet/CCEA 4->8), the per-cluster item counts, and the bottom summary chart's bar widths to match. State-wire volume (584, from collect_state_news.py) was left untouched and explicitly flagged as not refreshed this round -- that script was not found in any repo checked. Title's date range extended to reflect the new window. Lint-clean, JS-parse-clean, 10/10 house rules.
